test-vm-timeout-escape-promise.js: Needs a context with its own microtask queue (microtaskMode: 'afterEvaluate') and a timeout over it; V8 microtask queues and execution termination aren't available to browser JavaScript.

test-vm-script-after-evaluate.js: Needs a context with its own microtask queue (microtaskMode: 'afterEvaluate'); a browser has one microtask queue per agent and no API for another.
test-vm-module-after-evaluate.js: Needs a context with its own microtask queue (microtaskMode: 'afterEvaluate'); a browser has one microtask queue per agent and no API for another.
test-vm-harmony-symbols.js: Needs a context with its own builtins (its Symbol differs from the main one); a browser worker can't create another V8 realm, so contexts share the worker's builtins.
